subject: plot with POSIXct variable not working after upgrade

messages.author: 461a0c7d7557dffc
messages.subject: plot with POSIXct variable not working after upgrade
parts:
Hi All,

I've just upgraded R [and all packages] to version 2.11.1 on Win XP
SP3 machine.

I tried reruning my old plots and found some strange errors that seem
to be beyond my comprehension.

I have a data frame with POSIXct variable 'sessionstarttime' and when
I tried graphing it with:

tot_hist_countses <- ggplot(bigMAC, aes(x = sessionstarttime)) +
geom_freqpoly(size =1.25, alpha=0.4) + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Number of
sessions") + opts(title = "Daily number of sessions")

I got error msg:

Error in get("make_aesthetics", env = x, inherits = TRUE)(x, ...) :
could not find function "empty"

Is there anything I can do to fix this issue?

Thanks in advance,
Radek

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: plot with POSIXct variable not working after upgrade
parts:
Hello,

Sorry, I should have clarified. I did not mean that as an immediate
fix, just an explanation that the problem was known.

I believe the update has not yet percolated through the system fully.
A quick check over at CRAN

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/plyr/index.html

shows that the Windows binaries are still on 0.1.9 and the CRAN Checks
indicate that that version 1.0 did not pass them (and hence is not
available for download). You can also see that Hadley has kindly
uploaded 1.0.2, and once that becomes fully available, should fix the
problem (per that earlier thread).

Best regards,

Josh
